title: Sling: pre-flight walkaround with two findings
briefing: The Sling 2 is parked at 1N7 runway 07 and something is wrong with it, twice. Walk the whole POH section 4.4 pre-flight inspection and find both problems by looking at the aircraft, not at the panel. Do not fly with a no-go finding. Take the covers, chocks, and ropes off as the list says. The findings are chosen at random from the common ones; the same seed always chooses the same two. This is simulated practice, not a substitute for the aircraft's own handbook.
